title: Oakwood Veneer — Species Sample Book
description: Independent catalog and UX review of oakwoodveneer.com by Mousa Batarseh — 300+ species behind two filters, a 6.6-second mobile LCP, and a working species-faceted browser. For the Digital & Content Marketing role.

blocks.text: FOR THE DIGITAL & CONTENT MARKETING ROLE

Your category titles promise “300+ species,” but /veneer-sheets/ can only be filtered by Price and Quality — no species, cut, size or backer. The mobile homepage takes 6.6 seconds to paint its hero on a 5.7 MB page that also disables pinch-zoom. This sample book shows the gap, a working species-faceted browser, and the mobile patch I'd ship first.

Four edits against four failed Lighthouse audits, then facets and a content engine.
Six years of catalog SEO and store operations; veneer I'd be learning from your team.
E-commerce & website operations specialist in Warren, MI — eight miles from Troy. Six years running Shopify, WooCommerce and WordPress catalogs; SEO, GA4/Search Console, Mailchimp/Klaviyo-ready.

Independent, unsolicited review. Species names and any Oakwood references are used only as evidence for the findings; the Species Atlas swatches are illustrative CSS, not Oakwood product imagery.
